Commentary.Commentary: Who will come out to bat for Pakistan? It is Iftikhar Ahmed and Khushdil Shah who are coming out to bat for Pakistan. Who will be the bowler now for Zimbabwe? Blessing Muzarabani it is.

Zimbabwe will be very disappointed with their performance. They had the game in their bag but the last few overs, they were really poor especially in the field. Poor stuff and this match shouldn't have gone to a Super Over but it has and given Pakistan a real chance of a victory. Terrible fielding performance from the visitors. Chisoro should have stopped the last ball comfortably.

What a match we have had! After 100 overs of exciting cricket, we have ended up with a Super Over. Pakistan were all out of this game but Babar Azam's century and Wahab Riaz's fifty brought them back. Both Riaz and Azam fell at the end and gave Zimbabwe a chance but Musa Khan had other plans as he finished with two boundaries to take the match to a Super Over.
SUPER OVER! What has Tendai Chisoro done? Given a Super Over. Full ball outside off, Musa drives it to extra cover where Chisoro misfields, allowing the batters to take a boundary. SUPER OVER.
Full on middle, Hasnain heaves it to deep mid-wicket for a single. 5 needed from 1. 4 for a Super Over.
Short ball outside off, Hasnain looks to power it to the off side but it takes the outer half of the bat and goes wide of the long off fielder. A couple taken. 6 required from 2 balls.
Well bowled! A dot. Short ball outside off, Hasnain looks to guide it to third man but misses.
Fullish outside off, Musa thrashes it to deep cover but just a single this time.
FOUR! What a great start to the final over. Full outside off, Musa hammers it past the bowler and into the fence for a boundary. 9 from 5.
Mohammad Hasnain comes in to bat now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Babar Azam departs! Is that the end of the game for Pakistan? A 5-fer for Muzarabani! Brilliant stuff. Look at the celebrations. They know that they are within distance of a victory. Short ball around off, Azam looks to cut but it takes the top edge and goes to the keeper. Taylor makes no mistake and starts celebrating. The umpire raises his finger and Azam has to go. What an innings from him but it comes to an end. Azam will be disappointed to not have taken his side home.
Muhammad Musa comes in to bat now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Sikandar Raza has redeemed himself with this great catch. Babar Azam will not be happy with the shot that Afridi has played. Full outside off, Afridi looks to hammer it out of the park but gets a top edge and goes towards cover. Raza runs forward from the deep and then dives forward to take a good catch. 13 from 7 needed for Pakistan.
SWING AND A MISS! Short ball outside off, Afridi looks to pull but misses. 13 needed from 8.
Full toss on the pads, Azam works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! Great shot from Azam. What a Super Stike from Azam. That lifts the pressure. Full on the pads, Azam powers it over deep square leg for a biggie.
PLAY AND A MISS! Good start for Zimbabwe. Good length ball outside off, Azam looks to hammer it but loses his shape and misses.
Full on off, Azam drives it to long off for a single. 20 needed from 2 overs.
Full on middle, Azam heaves it to mid-wicket. He refuses the single. The fielder throws it to the bowler who whips the bails off but Afridi was in.
Short ball outside off, Afridi punches it to third man for another run.
Very full outside off, Azam digs it to point where the fielder fumbles and the batters take a single.
Shortish outside off, Afridi guides it to third man for a single.
Good length ball on off, Afridi defends it to point.
FOUR! Beautifully driven. Fullish ball outside off, Azam leans forward and drives it through the extra cover region for a boundary.
Is there a twist in the tale? As Shaheen Afridi is the new man in with the bat.

OUT! CAUGHT! A wicket at the right time for Zimbabwe. They are right back into the game. A magnificent partnership comes to an end. Full on middle, Riaz looks to go ove long on but does not time it well. Williams runs across from long on and takes a good catch. 28 needed from 19 balls.
Very full on the pads, Riaz looks to flick but misses.
Full on middle, Azam drives it to long on for a single.100-run partnership comes up.
WIDE! Down the leg side, Azam leaves it alone. Wided.
Shortish on middle, Riaz works it to deep square leg for a single.
Short ball on middle, Azam pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
PLAY AND A MISS! Good length ball outside off, Riaz looks to play the cut but misses.
Short ball on middle, Azam pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Length ball on off, punched to point.
Short ball outside off, Azam cuts it through the point region for a couple.
Slower ball outside off, Azam guides it to third man and picks up a couple before the fielder cuts it off.
Full outside off, Azam drives it to point where the fielder makes a good stop.
Richard Ngarava is back on.
SIX! What a way to reach 50! What an innings from Riaz. Full on middle, Riaz heaves it over the deep mid-wicket region for a biggie. 37 needed from 5 overs.
Length ball on the pads, Azam flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
Just short! Full ball outside off, Riaz plays it uppishly towards deep cover. It lands safely and the batters pick up a run.

DROPPED! What is Sikandar Raza doing? Has he dropped the game for Zimbabwe. He drops a sitter and it is of Wahab Riaz. Flighted ball on middle, Riaz looks to sweep but it takes the top edge and goes towards deep mid-wicket. Raza settles himself but fails to hold on. A single taken.

CENTURY! 12th ODI century for Babar Azam. First as captain. It has been an excellent innings but he knows that the job is not done yet and will want to take his side home. Full on middle, Azam flicks it to deep square leg for a single. Can he take his side home?
Flatter on middle, Riaz works it to mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! This will release some pressure. Tossed up on middle, Riaz goes on his knees and then slog sweeps it over deep mid-wicket for a maximum.
Flatter ball outside off, Riaz punches it through the cover-point region. Madhevere runs across and slides to make the stop. Two taken.
Sikandar Raza is done for tonight. Who will it be now? Tendai Chisoro will bowl now. 6-0-35-0 from him.

PLAY AND A MISS! That was very close. Quicker outside off, Riaz looks to guide it to third man but misses. 69 needed from 54 balls.

Loopy ball on middle, Azam nudges it to square leg.

Some more relaxation in the field for the fielding side as Powerplay 3 is announced. Now, Chamu Chibhaha can have 5 fielders outside the 30-yard circle till the innings end.

NOT OUT! There was an inside edge on it and Riaz is not out. Zimbabwe lose all their reviews. Poor review. Flatter on middle, Riaz looks to flick but he seems to have missed it. Zimbabwe appeal but the umpire is not interested. Zimbabwe take the review. The Ultra Edge rolls in and it shows that there was an inside edge on it.

Review time! LBW call against Riaz is not out and Zimbabwe take it upstairs. Replays roll in and it is a fair delivery. Ultra Edge comes in and it spots a spike when the ball is close to the bat and it stays as not out. Riaz survives.

EDGY FOUR! Not what Wahab intended to do but him and Pakistan will not care! Flatter around off, Riaz looks to heave this away but it kisses his outside edge and runs away to the third man fence for a boundary.

DRINKS! The game is nicely poised with Zimbabwe requiring another 4 wickets to seal a victory and Pakistan needing 105 more. The one man standing in between is the skipper of Pakistan, Babar Azam. He is well set and going good with his 80 runs. He will be eying his ton and look to see his team home. He will also remember that there is no batting left after Wahab Riaz. Whereas, Zimbabwe would want to see the back of either Azam or Riaz to get into the bowlers. Will they be able to scalp one more and get a step closer to victory or will Babar and Riaz see their side home?
FOUR! Riaz ends the over on a good note with a boundary. Flatter around middle, Riaz pulls this one to deep square leg and will find the fence. 105 needed in 15 overs.

There is an appeal and the umpire says no. Zimbabwe go for the review straightaway. Ultra Edge shows nothing. Ball Tracker comes in and the impact is outside off. The on-field decision stays and so does Babar Azam.

Review time! Zimbabwe have taken  a review against Babar Azam. Lets see what the replays have to say. Fair delivery, no bat involved and Ultra Edge confirms it. Ball Tracker comes on and Impact is outside off. The on field decision stands and Zimbabwe lose the review.

OUT! CAUGHT! The plan to bring back the pacer has worked out for Zimbabwe as they break apart this partnership. Peach of a delivery to get rid of Khushdil and Zimbabwe will believe that they are back into this game. Brilliantly bowled. Muzarabani bowls this one on a length and gets it to move away from the left hander. Khushdil is tempted into the drive and goes for it but the ball kisses his outside edge and goes to the keeper who is not going to drop these. Just the breakthrough that Zimbabwe needed.

OUT! TIMBER! This is terrific bowling from Donald Tiripano. Iftikhar Ahmed cannot believe what has happened. How many times have we seen a wicket fall immediately after Drinks? Ahmed plays a loose shot and he perishes. Good length ball on off, angling in. Ahmed looks to drive without moving his feet at all. The ball sneaks in between his bat and pad and it goes onto hit the stumps. 191 required from 195 balls.
Length ball on middle, Azam works it to deep square leg for a single.
Full on middle, Azam flicks it to mid-wicket.

DRINKS! So far it has been Zimbabwe with the ball. They took the mantle from their batters and came steaming in at the Pakistan top order. The Pakistan top order did not show the desired intent and fell to the Zimbabwean seamers. The good thing for Pakistan is that their skipper is still out there and he is their last hope. On the other hand, Zimbabwe would like to snare a couple of quick wickets and get into the bowling all-rounders of Pakistan. Who will come out on top? We will find out after the break.

Ouch! Short ball on middle, Azam looks to pull but misses and gets hit on the body. That must have sting.

Are Pakistan too going the Zimbabwe way? The African minnows too started on a similar note losing 3 wickets in the Powerplay. Can Pakistan script a comeback with a partnership like their opponents? Or will Zimbabwe continue to chip in wickets?

LEG BYE! Back of a length ball around leg, Rizwan looks to flick but misses and it comes off his pads towards square leg. The batters collect a leg bye.
On a good length on off, Rizwan pushes this towards point but denies the single on this occasion.
Back of a length ball outside off, Rizwan shoulders arms to this one.
PLAY AND A MISS! Great bowling by Muzarabani. On a good length around off, Rizwan looks to defend this one but it whizzes past his outside edge into the mitts of the keeper.
Good length on off, Rizwan works this towards mid on.
Back of a length ball on off, Azam blocks this one out.
FOUR! Classic Babar Azam! He needs to continue this. On a good length around off, Babar punches this through the extra cover region to bag a boundary.
On off, pushed towards point.
Back of a length ball on off, Rizwan guides this past the diving fielder at point to open his account.
PLAY AND A MISS! On a good length around off, Rizwan looks to defend this one but misses it.
Mohammad Rizwan is the new man in.

OUT! LBW! THREE REDS! Another one bites the dust for Pakistan! What is going on with their batting? They just don't seem to want to stay out in the middle. Zimbabwe are on top right now. On a good length around middle and leg, Ali looks to flick this one but misses and gets hit on the pads. The players appeal loudly and the umpire agrees by raising his finger. Ali talks to his skipper and decides to take the review. There is no spike as the ball passes the bat. Ball Tracker rolls in and there are three reds. Ali continues his walk back to the hut and takes a review along as well.

Review Time! Another LBW and Pakistan take the review. Haider Ali is the man in question. Replays come in and it looks plumb still Babar forces Haider to go for the review.  Legal delivery and nothing on the Ultra Edge. Now time for Ball Tracker, pitching in Line, impact in line and wickets hitting. Three reds and Pakistan lose a review as well a wicket.
On off, pushed towards the cover region.
On a good length on off, Ali tucks this towards mid-wicket and instantly goes for the single.
Good length ball on off, Ali looks to defend but it takes the inside edge and hits his body. A dot.
Good length delivery on middle, Ali blocks this towards mid on.
On off, pushed towards point.
Good length on off, Azam looks to defend but it comes off his outside edge towards third man for a single.
FOUR! Haider Ali is making his intentions very clear! Three boundaries in this over. On a good length around off, Ali creams his drive through the cover region to find the fence.
Short of a good length ball on off, Ali pushes this towards the cover region.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries for Ali! He was quick to pounce on this ball! Back of a length ball around leg, Ali tickles this one towards the fine leg region to collect another boundary.
FOUR! What a start by the youngster Haider Ali! Back of a length ball outside off, Ali slashes this through the backward point region to collect a boundary.
Who will it be for Pakistan now? Haider Ali it is.

OUT! LBW! UMPIRE'S CALL! Zimbabwe are red hot right now and they have scalped another wicket. Disastrous start by the hosts. Losing two wickets in the first two overs. Zimbabwe have started off really well. On a good length around off, Zaman looks to work this to the leg side but misses and gets hit on the pads. The players appeal and the umpire obliges by raising his finger. Zaman goes for the review straightaway. Nothing on Ultra Edge. Ball Tracker comes in and the decision is umpire's call. Zaman will have to walk back now. Top start by Zimbabwe and they will look to continue this.

Review time! Fakhar Zaman has been given the marching orders by the on field umpire after an LBW appeal from the bowler. He straightaway goes for the 'T'. Lets see what happens as the replays come in. Fair delivery it is. Lets see what the front on spin vision has to say. Looks to be no edge there and the Ultra Edge confirms it. Now the Ball Tracker comes on and it says Umpire's Call on hitting the Stumps. Zaman's return to the side is a bitter one as he continues his march towards the pavillion.
Good length around off, Zaman pushes this towards the cover region to collect a couple.
Who will it be from the other end with the ball for Zimbabawe? Richard Ngarava to partner Muzarabani.
A dot to end the over. Short ball on middle, Azam ducks under this and lets it go.
Good length on off, pushed towards the cover region.
Good length outside off, Azam leaves it alone.
What a start from Zimbabwe. They have picked up an early wicket.
Babar Azam is the next man in.

OUT! TIMBER! Zimbabwe strike in the first over and Imam walks back. What a comeback this is by Blessing as he was sent to the boundary ropes.  Just the start that Zimbabwe needed and Imam will be very disappointed with this. On a good length around middle and off, Imam strides forward and looks to have a poke at this but he misses this and this goes onto hit the stumps. Brilliant from Blessing.
On a full length around off, Imam leaves it alone.
FOUR! What a way to start off by Imam and Pakistan! Fullish length ball on the pads, Imam flicks this towards the fine leg region for a boundary.
